title: Corrected cost target matches broker financing; neural validation error lower
interpretation: Version-two target includes pending allocation financing. Twenty development replays retain identical financial result hashes, with exact broker financing in isolated-position cases. Neural validation RMSEs 0.11470 and 0.11202 virtual USD versus ridge 0.13982 and quoted control 0.18733 across 91 source groups. Selected seed29 remains final-test-unopened. These are synthetic hypothetical cost estimates, not policy/economic value.

selection.criterion: Minimum mean validation source-group RMSE by family; prefer ridge within 0.005 virtual USD RMSE. Representative seed has minimum validation RMSE. No policy promotion.

limitations: Exploratory synthetic validation evidence; final tests remain unopened.
Model selection reuses validation; comparison intervals do not correct selection or multiplicity.
Ledger/component arithmetic is independently checked; fitted predictions use the recorded regression implementation.

caveats: Exploratory synthetic validation evidence; final tests remain unopened.
Model selection reuses validation; comparison intervals do not correct selection or multiplicity.

next_experiment: Freeze and verify the pretest bundle, then preregister one selected-model final evaluation without retraining or policy promotion.
